integrity.claim_scope: Uniformly random finite-field Lie ideals of the free class-two nilpotent Lie algebra, generator-rank limit
integrity.proof_type: complete analytic proof plus independent finite enumerations

scientific_limitations: Asymptotic requires fixed prime power q and d to infinity; no joint-limit claim.
The elementary exact ideal count is established enumeration machinery and is not represented as the primary novelty.
Earlier asymptotic work may imply this statement; independent priority and proof audit are not performed.
title: Theta-modulated cubic suppression of noncentral ideals in free class-two Lie algebras
